features.name: Acid Cap Resistance
features.description: You have resistance to acid damage.

features.name: Acid Spores
features.description: When you are hit by a melee weapon attack within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to emit acidic spores. The attacker takes acid damage equal to half your level (rounded up). You can use this a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of once). Regain all uses on a long rest.

payload.name: Acid Spores
payload.description: Reaction to melee attacker within 5 ft; deals acid damage equal to half your level.

features.name: Clan Athlete
features.description: You have proficiency in the Athletics skill.
